project_name: Unnamed Brantley County data center zoning allowance
status_detail: County public notices show a January 20, 2026 public hearing to add Data Centers as a Special Exception in the Brantley County Land Use Chart. Local news reported continued public discussion around a proposed land-use amendment, but no specific applicant/site/capacity was found.
notes: Official evidence confirms zoning-process activity for data centers, not a named project. A later Brantley County public notice stated a June 24, 2026 rezoning request was not for a data center and that a state development grant prohibits data centers on that tract.

project_name: Unnamed Brooks County / Arden area data center
status_detail: Community reports described a possible data center in western Brooks County along Southern Boulevard near Arden. notes: Low-confidence project lead; official records found show moratorium/ordinance activity rather than a project approval.

status_detail: Statesboro Planning Commission voted 5-1 on August 4, 2026 to recommend rezoning for a proposed data center at 6539 Burkhalter Road; final City Council approval and a separate special use permit were still required. County moratorium does not apply because the site is inside city jurisdiction.
notes: Proposed two-story 230,000 sf facility on about 26.5-26.94 acres, with 32,000 sf substation and concept-plan power requirement of 40-90 MW. Average makeup water estimated at 30-100 gpd; peak domestic/cooling demand about 1,000 gpd; monthly average reported as 12,000 gpd.

project_name: AWS Butts County data center campus
status_detail: AWS announced plans to invest in new data centers in Butts and Douglas counties as part of an estimated $11 billion Georgia infrastructure expansion supporting cloud and AI technologies. Butts County Development Authority homepage also states AWS has announced a new data center campus in Butts County.
notes: AWS did not disclose exact site or county-level split of the $11B/550 jobs in the public announcement. Cleanview tracks multiple planned 69 MW Butts buildings, but that is tracker evidence and not used as primary capacity.

status_detail: Georgia DCA DRI #4560 was submitted by Butts County and marked completed in the DRI process; the project description includes approximately 11 million square feet of data center(s), medical office space, a hospital, and commercial uses, with estimated build-out in 2040.
notes: DRI lists site coordinates 33.26342, -84.085402 and parcel IDs; 11M sf data center component; estimated value at build-out $10B; water demand 4.54 MGD; wastewater 1.73 MGD; estimated completion 2040. DRI energy MW field was blank/TBD in available form.

project_name: Kingsland industrial park / data center rezoning
aliases: V V Farm / Sapling Farms data center
developer: Kirk Tovey-linked entities (V V Farm Inc. and Sapling Farms LLC)
status_detail: Kirk Tovey-linked companies sought rezoning/annexation for nearly 700 acres along I-95 and Laurel Island Parkway in Kingsland/Camden County for an industrial park that would allow data centers. Camden County and Kingsland considered/adopted moratorium responses while the rezoning was pending.
notes: About 500+ acres were reportedly already inside Kingsland city limits and about 146 acres were proposed for annexation. Developer/site details are from local news and Kingsland agenda references; county zoning page and agenda center were checked for official planning context.
